limitations: One full30k stochastic pair, no precision/confidence claims from it

Five-era partial canonical CORR is a finite/nonconstant sanity check, not selection evidence

Warmup diagnostic logging is excluded from timed draws; actual bin metadata remains recorded
Shared system wisdom is read/copied before/after each worker; initial cache/tuner effects remain inside train timing
Warmup diagnostics prove observed engagement only for that warmup; timed draws do not emit diagnostic logging
All finite canonical metrics remain in raw records, including incomplete/failed models; headline timings require complete sane uncontended models
